annotation.evidence_span: A receiver MUST treat the receipt of any other type of frame or a frame on a different stream
annotation.interpretation_a: The receiver must treat *any* other frame type as an error, even if that frame type is valid in other contexts (e.g., a PING frame).
annotation.interpretation_b: The receiver must treat any frame that is *not* a CONTINUATION frame as an error, implying that other frame types are permissible at other times.
annotation.justification: The phrase "any other type of frame" is broad. It doesn't specify whether all frame types are disallowed after receiving a CONTINUATION frame, or only those that are not part of the continuation sequence. This leads to two reasonable interpretations regarding the allowed frame types.
annotation.missing_information: It is unclear whether the receiver should treat *all* other frame types as errors, or only those that are unexpected in the current context. A constraint specifying the valid frame types at this point in the protocol would resolve the ambiguity.
